title: Algebraic Hodge Loci and Exceptional Correspondences

description: We construct algebraic Hodge classes in explicit abelian and K3 families and reduce abelian transfer to primitive middle-degree classes on rational varieties. Exact correspondence formulas and bounded-support criteria isolate the generic mixed Mumford class. Its algebraicity and the universal Hodge conjecture remain open. Based on the full 112-page v3.4.1 draft at commit e44529e5597b1145d7008750968d577e1e1df4c9. Retains every original main-text paragraph, all earlier sections, appendices and figures, the short abstract, title and both authors. Adds Appendix F on the separate Fermat-fourfold results, credits Hongmin Li's September theorem-level precedent and later positive classification, and preserves credit to Jumagulov for the seed constructions. The appendix explains the tensor-filtration failure and the correspondence actually required to transfer algebraicity. The generic mixed Mumford class, F2, F3-prime and the general Hodge conjecture remain unproved.
